description: Source code for a plugin test store implementation in the focalboard server project, including user, team, channel, and license management functions.

classes.name: PluginTestStore
classes.description: A mock implementation of a store for testing plugin functionalities, managing users, teams, channels, and licenses.

methods.name: GetTeam
methods.description: Retrieve a team by ID, returning predefined teams or an error.

methods.name: GetTeamsForUser
methods.description: Retrieve teams associated with a user based on user ID.

methods.name: GetUserByID
methods.description: Retrieve a user by their ID.

methods.name: GetUsersList
methods.description: Retrieve a list of users by their IDs.

methods.name: GetUsersByTeam
methods.description: Retrieve users belonging to a specific team.

methods.name: SearchUsersByTeam
methods.description: Search users within a team based on a search query.

methods.name: CanSeeUser
methods.description: Determine if one user can see another based on guest status and shared board membership.

methods.name: SearchUserChannels
methods.description: Search for channels associated with a user in a team.

methods.name: GetChannel
methods.description: Retrieve a channel by team ID and channel ID.

methods.name: SearchBoardsForUser
methods.description: Search for boards accessible to a user, filtered by team membership.

methods.name: GetLicense
methods.description: Retrieve or generate a license object, with optional compliance feature based on environment variable.
